title: Declare an offline e2e gate for Forgel's own self-hosting pipeline
requirements: Add an e2e entry to environment.yaml with a command list that runs an offline end-to-end smoke of Forgel on itself: adopt a local fixture repository, plan a milestone with the scripted model, run one task through coding agent, task QA and review, and stop at the staging approval gate.
The self-hosting e2e must run with FORGEL_MODEL_MODE=script, must not touch the network, Docker or cloud resources, and must finish within a couple of minutes.
Add tests/e2e/ self-hosting driver (or extend the existing one) that the environment.yaml e2e command invokes and that exits non-zero on a red gate.
Extend tests/test_environment.py to assert that environment.yaml declares both test and e2e and that the e2e command parses into a non-empty argument list.
acceptance: The environment test passes with an e2e declaration.
The self-hosting e2e command exits 0 in the repository sandbox, asserted by the suite run that invokes it.
The e2e run stops at the staging approval gate and never reaches done without an approval, asserted by the driver.
constraints: No external services, cloud resources or network calls.
Deterministic output; clean up temporary directories.
Do not weaken existing tests; keep the suite green.
plan_goal: Довести проект до выхода на M1 (публичная OSS-альфа): вертикальный срез Django/DRF + React SPA + Postgres + S3 на Yandex Cloud, multi-repo, независимый e2e QA в изолированном стенде, staging с подтверждением человеком, учёт стоимости и приёмок, самохостинг Forgel на самом себе. Первой задачей — проставить в PLAN.md и README отметки о том, что из M0/M0.5 уже сделано, чтобы список отражал реальность.

checks.criterion: environment.yaml declares test and e2e and the e2e command parses
Self-hosting e2e driver exits 0 and parks at the staging gate
Full suite is green after the change
